objective_for_doctor: Evaluate the patient presenting with fatigue, malaise, and unintentional weight loss, and assess the need for further diagnostic workup.

turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: For the last few months I’ve had fatigue and just feeling generally unwell. I’ve also lost about 18 kilograms without intending to, and I haven’t changed my diet or exercise to explain it.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in your joints?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any swelling in my joints, and I don’t have any particular joint pain or stiffness. It’s mostly been this ongoing fatigue and feeling generally unwell along with the weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on your scalp?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on my scalp. It’s mostly been the ongoing fatigue and the significant unintentional weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a feeling of itchiness anywhere on your body?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any itching or a feeling of itchiness anywhere on my body.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any trouble lifting your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had trouble lifting my arms above my head—my strength feels mostly reduced because of the fatigue, not because I can’t raise them.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any loss of vision, and I haven’t had any vision problems along with pain. It’s mainly been fatigue and the significant unintentional weight loss that’s been worrying me.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had a fever that’s felt extremely hot—like a temperature above 104 °F (40 °C) that’s made you feel dizzy or very uncomfortable?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had a fever like that, and I haven’t felt dizzy or extremely uncomfortable from high temperatures. It’s mostly been persistent fatigue and the unintentional weight loss over the last few months.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I wouldn’t say I’ve been unusually stressed or overwhelmed. It’s been more of a persistent fatigue and malaise, along with the unintentional weight loss, rather than anything that feels tied to stress.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any burning or discomfort when you urinate?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any burning or discomfort when I urinate. It’s mostly been the ongoing fatigue and the significant unintentional weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling chills lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had chills. It’s mainly been persistent fatigue and the unintentional weight loss over the past several months.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breasts that feel fixed or don’t move?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or masses in my breasts—nothing that feels fixed or doesn’t move. It’s mainly this ongoing fatigue and the unintentional weight loss that’s been concerning me.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling any pain or discomfort on the side of your back or abdomen, between your ribs and hips?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any pain or discomfort on the side of my back or abdomen between my ribs and hips. It’s been mainly persistent fatigue and the unintentional weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel pain in your calf when you walk, and does it go away when you stop and rest?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any calf pain when I walk—there’s no discomfort that comes on with walking and improves when I rest. It’s mainly been the persistent fatigue and the significant unintentional weight loss.”
